postconditions.description: The number of vertices in the tree is between 1 and 2 * 10^5, inclusive.
The number of edges in the tree is n - 1.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
postconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the range of vertex labels.
The given edges form a valid tree.
There exists at least one pair of pairs of vertices that satisfy the conditions.

invariants.expression: all(u in vertices and v in vertices for u, v in edges)
invariants.description: Each edge connects two vertices that are part of the tree.
The tree is connected, meaning there is a path between any two vertices.
The tree is acyclic, meaning no cycle exists in the graph.
